newsitem.title: UK: Body Shop drops after Xmas trading statement.
newsitem.headline: Body Shop drops after Xmas trading statement.

text.p: Shares in Body Shop International Plc dropped on Wednesday after the British cosmetic retailer reported a fall in like-for-like sales in the Christmas period.
Body Shop shares were seven pence lower at 188-1/2p by 0924 GMT.

Like-for-like store sales were down 2.0 percent in the 10 weeks to January 4 and were unchanged in the 44 weeks to January 4. Total retail sales were up 6.0 percent in the 10-week period and 10 percent in the 44-week period, Body Shop said.
"The sales figures were certainly lower than people were hoping," one market-maker said.
